mapper.select: SELECT B.BOARD_NO , B.BOARD_TYPE , CODE_NAME AS BOARD_TYPE_NAME , B.COMPANY_CODE , B.SUBJECT , B.CONTENTS , B.READ_COUNT , TO_CHAR(B.CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATE_DATE , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(B.START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(B.END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE , B.CREATE_BY , B.PARENT_BOARD_NO , B.MAIN_POPUP_YN FROM BOARD B INNER JOIN CODE_DTL CD ON B.COMPANY_CODE = CD.COMPANY_CODE AND B.BOARD_TYPE = CD.CODE AND CD.CATEGORY = 'BT' WHERE B.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND B.BOARD_NO = #{board_no}

SELECT B.COMPANY_CODE , B.BOARD_NO , B.FILE_SEQ , B.ORIGIN_FILE_NAME , B.FILE_SIZE , B.CONTENT_TYPE FROM BOARD_FILE B WHERE B.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND B.BOARD_NO = #{board_no} ORDER BY FILE_SEQ DESC

SELECT COMPANY_CODE , BOARD_NO , FILE_SEQ , ORIGIN_FILE_NAME , FILE_SIZE , CONTENT_TYPE , BOARD_FILE_FIELD AS FILE_DATA FROM BOARD_FILE WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND BOARD_NO = CAST(#{board_no} AS BIGINT) AND FILE_SEQ = CAST(#{file_seq} AS SMALLINT)
